Written for her

A Letter in Verse

To the girl who carries quiet magic in the way she walks through life

Happy Birthday, Princilia.

Princilia, you are a rare kind of strength
not loud, not forceful,
but steady…
like something the world cannot shake.

You have this calm in you,
this peace that feels deeper than words,
like your soul already knows
everything will be okay.

You are strong-headed in the most beautiful way
you stand by what you believe in,
you know your worth,
and you never settle for anything less
than what your heart truly deserves.

There's a softness in you too,
a warmth that makes people feel safe,
a love that feels pure and real
the kind that doesn't need to prove itself,
because it simply is.

And then there's your spirit
so deeply connected, so effortlessly divine
like you were made to shine in ways
the world hasn't even discovered yet.

✦   ✦   ✦

On your birthday, I don't just wish you happiness

I wish you growth that excites you,
peace that stays with you,
dreams that chase you back,
and a future so bright
it matches the light you already carry inside.

Keep becoming. Keep rising.
Keep being exactly who you are
because that alone is
something truly extraordinary.

Happy Birthday, Princilia.
The world is better simply because you're in it. 💫
